Definition: to pour out (literally or figuratively), i.e. empty
BiblicalUsage: In Hebrew, rûwq means to pour out (literally or figuratively), that is empty. It stands in Ecclesiastes 11:3, "…the tree fall toward the south, or toward…", and in Exodus 15:9, "…overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rûwq is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
